preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex in the edges is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in result)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(max_k_valid_set_size(k) == result[k-1] for k in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The i-th number in the output is the maximum possible size of a k-valid set of simple paths for k from 1 to n.
